# GHIST+-Adapt v3 results (auto-generated by report_v3.py)

Mean over 3 repeats of the core placement. Evaluation = every cell >200 um from all cores. ✅ = better than GHIST+ on that metric (for median PCC also requires the block-bootstrap 95% CI of the gain to exclude 0 in every repeat).

## What the adapter learned (biology)

For each corrected gene that belongs to a marker programme: the share of its correction weight (|W|, standardised inputs, self excluded) that comes from other genes of the *same* programme, divided by the share expected if weight were spread evenly. >1 = the correction uses biologically related genes. Signs in the examples: + = higher input raises the corrected gene, − = lowers it (e.g. mutually exclusive compartments). Co-expressed inputs are correlated, so weights reflect co-expression structure, not causal regulation.

| slide | programme | genes (corrected) | mean within-programme enrichment | example: top inputs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| breast5k | T | 4 (3) | 1.3× | CD3E ← −CTTN, +NLRC5, −STAT3, −IL2RG |
| breast5k | Plasma | 4 (1) | 1.6× | TENT5C ← +MUC1, −CCDC6, +POSTN, +PECAM1 |
| breast5k | Macrophage | 5 (3) | 0.9× | C1QC ← +FGFR1, +PDE4A, −IGF1, −MYO5B |
| breast5k | Myeloid | 7 (3) | 0.9× | CLEC9A ← +RGS5, −ADGRL4, +CD8A, −GZMA |
| breast5k | Stromal | 8 (4) | 1.7× | LUM ← −PGR, −GATA3, +ROR1, +FLNB |
| breast5k | Epithelial | 5 (4) | 3.1× | EPCAM ← +ANKRD30A, +TBX3, −FOXA1, +DUSP5 |
| breast5k | Malignant | 5 (4) | 1.9× | ERBB2 ← +ANKRD30A, +TBX3, −TFAP2A, +PGR |
